description: A strict push-up variation with a momentary pause at the bottom to eliminate rebound momentum.
setup: Start in a standard push-up plank with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and body formed in a straight line.
steps: Lower your chest with control until it hovers one inch off the floor.
Hold motionless at the bottom position for a full one to two seconds without resting on the floor.
Drive your palms through the floor to return forcefully to the starting plank.
cues: Maintain strict core tension during the bottom freeze
Keep elbows tucked at a 45-degree angle to protect your shoulders

mistakes.mistake: Collapsing hips or resting weight on the floor during the pause
mistakes.fix: Hover one inch above the ground while keeping glutes and abs tight

mistakes.mistake: Rushing out of the bottom pause before one full second
mistakes.fix: Count one thousand and one before pressing up

rep_standard: Begins at top plank lockout, requires a clear one-second static pause at bottom chest hover, and finishes at full lockout.
